A '''species''' of peaceful [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] creatures resided in [[Zarrak's mountain]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

It had the [[bill]] of a [[Duck/Legends|duck]] and the shell of a [[Turtle/Legends|turtle]]. [[Zarrak]], a user of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark magics]] was able to [[Metamorphosis|transform]] this creature into a much larger and fearsome form using his powers. He did this to show his apprentice, [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], how to transform creatures into aggressive animals. However, when Teebo attempted to transform the beast, he accidentally transformed [[stranglevine]]s instead, and the creature swam away.<ref name="TFA">{{Ewoks|The First Apprentice}}</ref>
